documents.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters

notes: thermal.glass_transition: the TDS (p.2, Physical Properties) states «Glass Transition Temperature DSC, 10 °C/min N/A»; no number is published.

TDS values with no registry key (not stored): Young's modulus X-Y 2450 ± 270 MPa / Z 2120 ± 260 MPa; melt index 7.0 ± 0.8 g/10 min (260 °C, 2.16 kg); saturated water absorption 0.45% (25 °C, 55% RH); crystallization temperature N/A; printing and storage humidity < 20% RH (sealed, with desiccant); retraction length 0.8 - 1.4 mm; retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s; max overhang angle ~ 70°; max bridging length ~ 40 mm; spool material PC + ABS (temperature resistance 90 °C); spool size diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm; annealing 80 to 90 °C for 6 to 12 h.

Z-direction mechanical values are not stored (one row per key, scope and region): tensile 31 ± 4 MPa, elongation 4.6 ± 0.8 %, bending modulus 1650 ± 120 MPa, bending strength 40 ± 3 MPa, impact 4.9 ± 0.6 kJ/m².

Every mechanical.* value is a printed-specimen result (TDS Specimen Test); the TDS publishes no raw-material mechanical values, so none are mixed. material.density, thermal.melting_temp, thermal.vicat_softening and thermal.heat_deflection_temp come from the TDS Physical Properties table.
In the box: no official in-the-box list exists for this product (the store page has none; the TDS has none).
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) and the spool type («Filament with spool») are published on the store page and kept from the deterministic layer; they are not listed as not_published.
